data.note: Prices are per bottle. Wines also poured by the glass list their glass price.

items.desc: Xarel·lo, Macabeu and Parellada from the fossil-rich soils of the Anoia valley, blushed with a splash of Monastrell and rested eighteen months on the lees: wild strawberry and blood orange on a fine, silky mousse, with a long, saline finish.
items.name: 2023 Raventós i Blanc de Nit Extra Brut Rosé Cava

items.desc: Grand Cru Pinot Noir from the chalk slopes of Verzenay and Verzy, part fermented in old oak and aged at least three years in the family’s chalk cellar: green apple, white peach and blackberry, firm and mineral, finishing on almond and anise.
items.name: NV Hugues Godmé Brut Blanc de Noirs Champagne

items.desc: Old-vine Meunier with a little Pinot Noir from the Marne’s right bank, on fossil-strewn sand, clay and limestone, wild-fermented in steel: orchard blossom and soft, round fruit, a gentle bitter lift and a clean, saline finish.
items.name: NV Philippe Gamet Rive Droite Brut Blanc de Noirs Champagne

items.desc: Grillo from red clay just thirty meters from the Mediterranean near Marsala, its second fermentation sparked with fresh grape must rather than sugar: green apple and white flowers, savory and mineral, with a finish that turns almost salty.
items.name: 2020 Barraco Terre Siciliane Grillo Pas Dosé Metodo Classico Vino Spumante

items.desc: Keuka Lake Riesling, pressed as whole clusters and aged at least two years on the lees before hand disgorging, finished with a gentle sweetness: apple, honey and spice, with firm acidity keeping it in balance. Lovely with oysters or fried food.
items.name: NV Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Célèbre Semi Dry Crémant

items.desc: A rare dry red sparkler from Cayuga Lake, blending peppery Lemberger with deep-colored Chambourcin: blackberry and dark berries, a lift of black pepper and a hint of tomato leaf. Serve lightly chilled with rich, savory food.
items.name: NV Goose Watch Finger Lakes Crimson Brut Sparkling Wine

items.src: Seneca Lake, New York · By the glass 18
items.desc: Estate Riesling from the Magdalena and Standing Stone vineyards, whole-cluster pressed, wild-fermented and aged thirty months on the lees: lemon curd, citrus peel and yellow apple, chalky and taut, with a fine, crisp mousse. A natural match for crab cakes.
items.name: NV Hermann J. Wiemer Vineyard Seneca Lake Extra Brut Méthode Champenoise Sparkling Wine

items.desc: Free-run juice of Catawba, one of America’s oldest wine grapes and the base of its first sparkling wines, made in a light, spritzy style: raspberry candy and sweet cherry, a hint of clove, sweet-tart and refreshing.
items.name: 2023 Lakewood Vineyards Bubbly Catawba Sweet Sparkling Rosé

items.desc: Riesling, whole-bunch pressed and wild-fermented, then bottled before fermentation finished so it sparkles on its own: pithy lemon and juicy peach, chalky minerality, fine natural bubbles and a bone-dry finish.
items.name: 2022 Living Roots Finger Lakes Pét-Nat Riesling

items.src: Finger Lakes, New York · By the glass 14
items.desc: Mostly hybrid grapes, picked early for a lighter, lower-alcohol sparkler, made in tank with grape juice driving the second fermentation, stopped early to leave a touch of sweetness: pretty florals, juicy watermelon and red fruit, bright acidity.
items.name: NV Living Roots Finger Lakes Session Sparkling Rosé

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York
items.desc: Hand-harvested Chardonnay and Pinot Noir from sandy loam between the Sound and Peconic Bay, bottle-fermented and aged two years on the lees with no sugar added: green apple, citrus and a touch of peach, a light buttery note and crisp, fresh acidity.
items.name: NV RGNY North Fork of Long Island Zero Dosage Sparkling Wine
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.desc: Estate Grüner Veltliner from the steep west shore of Cayuga Lake, fermented on its own yeasts and bottled before it finished for a gentle natural sparkle: pear, tart apple and lemon, then chalky, savory minerality and a crisp, dry finish.
items.name: 2020 Six Eighty Cellars Finger Lakes Grüner Veltliner Dry Pét-Nat

items.desc: In the Friulian mold, blended with about a fifth Cortese for a crisp, saline edge, from cool Sonoma and Lodi sites and fermented in neutral oak and foudre: fresh flowers, citrus, sea salt and almond, dry and bright. A natural aperitif.
items.name: 2024 Massican California Pinot Grigio

items.desc: Spicy, rose-scented Gewürztraminer and bright Vignoles from Seneca Lake’s east shore, fermented on their skins like a red for an amber hue and gentle grip: richly textured, savory and earthy, finishing on orange marmalade, grapefruit rind and dried flowers.
items.name: 2017 Atwater Estate Vineyards Finger Lakes Skin Ferment Gewürztraminer – Vignoles

items.desc: Viura from old vines spread across some three hundred small hillside parcels on limestone and clay below the Sierra de Cantabria, fermented in steel, concrete and old oak: stone fruit, white flowers and a hint of struck match, crisp, dry and lightly mineral.
items.name: 2023 Bideona Rioja Cabezadas Viura

items.desc: The rare Swiss grape of the Valais, from young estate vines on Onondaga limestone above Cayuga Lake, basket-pressed and raised in steel and neutral oak: peach, lime, lychee and mango, concentrated by the tiny 2022 crop, with a lively, citrus-driven palate.
items.name: 2022 Heart & Hands Finger Lakes Arvine

items.desc: Hondarrabi Zuri with a little of the rare Pyrenean Petit Corbu, grown high in the hills below Mount Hernio and fermented cool in steel to keep its natural spritz: citrus zest and green apple, a salty, mineral edge and bright acidity. Lovely with shellfish.
items.name: 2024 Inazio Getariako Txakolina Urruzola White Blend

items.desc: A special bottling named for the mountain that shelters the estate’s high vineyards above Alkiza, cooled by breezes off the Bay of Biscay and picked by hand: citrus, white flowers and ripe tropical fruit, with white peach and apple on the palate.
items.name: 2022 Inazio Getariako Txakolina Urruzola Naturala Hernio White Blend

items.desc: Organically farmed Pinot Gris fermented on its skins for a copper-salmon hue and light grip, lifted with direct-pressed Riesling, wild-fermented and raised in neutral oak: dried cherry, cranberry and white peach, soft herbs and a clean, mineral finish.
items.name: 2024 Maloof Willamette Valley 'Where Ya Pjs At?' White Blend

items.desc: Hondarrabi Zuri with a touch of red Hondarrabi Beltza from cliffside vines above Getaria’s harbor, whole-cluster pressed and bottled cold to keep its own natural spritz: tropical fruit on the nose, a fresh, fruity palate and bright, balanced acidity.
items.name: 2024 Ulacia Getariako Txakolina White Blend

items.desc: Chenin from four parcels of black schist, puddingstone and serpentine around Saint-Lambert-du-Lattay, biodynamically farmed and aged a year in oak vats and large barrels: a subtly reductive nose of almond, white fruit and quince, pure and refreshing, with a delicate finish.
items.name: 2022 Domaine Belargus Anjou Noir Chenin Blanc

items.desc: Chenin from clay and limestone over tuffeau chalk, hand-picked with a touch of noble rot and fermented slowly, stopped just short of dry: orange peel, ripe quince and a hint of honey, softly sweet, with a clean, dry-feeling finish.
items.name: 2023 Domaine de Vaufuget Vouvray Réserve du Naufraget Chenin Blanc

items.desc: Biodynamic Chenin from a steep little valley of schist, volcanic rhyolite and quartz, picked in two passes and aged a year on its lees in old barrels: golden apple, mirabelle and apricot, acacia honey and a creamy touch, racy and long.
items.name: 2022 Domaine du Closel-Château des Vaults Clos du Papillon Savennières Chenin Blanc

items.desc: A single south-facing parcel of white limestone beneath Vergisson’s great cliff, vines approaching a century old, farmed biodynamically and fermented in barrel: white flowers, white fruit and a touch of brioche, concentrated, with zesty lemon and a vibrant, mineral finish.
items.name: 2022 Domaine Saumaize-Michelin Pouilly-Fuissé Premier Cru sur La Roche Chardonnay

items.desc: Low-yielding, hand-picked Chardonnay from clay and limestone, whole-cluster pressed, wild-fermented and rested on its fine lees in steel with no oak: nectarine, peach and white flowers, a round texture from the warm 2023 season, and a flinty, saline finish.
items.name: 2023 Jean Manciat Mâcon-Charnay Chardonnay

items.desc: Chinon blanc, a rarity in Cabernet Franc country, from young, organically farmed vines at the top of the slope, on clay over chalky limestone: lemon, quince and apple, a chalky, mineral edge, a touch of bee pollen and the faintest hint of vanilla.
items.name: 2021 Olga Raffault Chinon Chenin des Picasses Chenin Blanc

items.desc: Passerina, an old white grape of central Italy, from a single plot in the hills of Piglio, farmed organically and fermented with native yeasts, unfined and unfiltered: white peach, pear and citrus blossom over wild herbs and crushed stone.
items.name: 2022 Abbia Nòva San Giovanni Lazio 'Passerina del Frusinate' Passerina

items.desc: Procanico, the local Trebbiano, from volcanic soils by Lake Bolsena, made in the image of the winemaker’s grandfather’s skin-fermented wine, with wild yeasts and no added sulfur: orange sherbet, apple and lemon zest, textured and rich, with gentle grip.
items.name: 2022 Cantina Ortaccio Dritto Bianco Procanico

items.desc: Hand-picked from quartz-porphyry slopes between Bolzano and Merano, fermented cool and rested half a year on its lees in steel: crisp apple and pear, a hint of raspberry, chamomile and lemongrass, finishing with a salty, mineral lift and a slight creaminess.
items.name: 2023 Cantina Terlano Alto Adige Terlano Tradition Pinot Bianco

items.src: Umbria, Italy · Sommelier selection · by the glass 20
items.desc: A Sardinian shepherd’s nod to home, grown on marl and limestone in the Umbrian hills, with a couple of days on the skins for a pale amber tint: stone fruit, grapefruit and honeysuckle, thyme and wild herbs, and a surprisingly saline finish.
items.name: 2024 Giovanni Battista Mesina Umbria 'I Vini di Giovanni Vermentuzzo' Vermentino

items.desc: Organic Ribolla from Savorgnano del Torre, the coolest, wettest corner of the appellation, on crumbly ponca marl, pressed directly and rested on its lees: acacia blossom, elderflower, aromatic herbs and a touch of anise, soft, clean and light-footed.
items.name: 2023 Marco Sara Colli Orientali del Friuli Ribolla Gialla

items.desc: Friulano from the gravelly Isonzo plain near Cormons, wild-fermented and aged eighteen months on its lees in steel, bottled unfiltered and now ten years on: yellow stone fruit and pear, a subtle floral and nutty depth, and a saline, bitter-almond finish.
items.name: 2016 Roncús Isonzo Friulano

items.desc: Viura from old bush vines on hilltop plots of limestone and chalky clay, made in steel and concrete with a portion fermented in French oak: stone fruit, citrus and pear, herbs and white flowers, taut and poised, with a saline, chalky finish.
items.name: 2021 Bideona Rioja Las Parcelas Viura

items.desc: Malvasía Volcánica from ungrafted vines set in hollows dug through Lanzarote’s black volcanic ash, whole-cluster pressed and rested on its lees without oak: lime, pear and passion fruit, wild fennel and white flowers over a deep, volcanic mineral core.
items.name: 2024 Bodegas Los Bermejos Lanzarote Malvasía Volcánica

items.desc: The Basque coast’s native white grape, grown on south-facing slopes below Mount Jaizkibel and rested on its fine lees with a faint natural spritz: pear, apple, grapefruit and passion fruit, a hint of orange blossom, and a crisp, citrusy finish. Lovely with oysters.
items.name: 2022 Hiruzta Getariako Txakolina Baskoli Hondarrabi Zuri

items.desc: Forty-year-old organic, dry-farmed vines on lime-rich soils, fermented with native yeasts in new 500-liter French oak and a concrete egg: quince, marzipan and dried apple over a savory, mineral palate with lively acidity. Lovely with shellfish.
items.name: 2021 Pardas Penedès Pur Xarel-Lo

items.desc: Organic, dry-farmed vines on stony soils around Corella, fermented with native yeasts and rested six months on the lees in concrete, foudre and large barrels: citrus, peach and apricot with a soft mineral edge, dry, fresh and medium-bodied.
items.name: 2022 Viña Zorzal Navarra Garnacha Blanca

items.desc: Estate Riesling from steep, hand-tended slate slopes around Wehlen, fermented with native yeasts and matured mostly in steel on its fine lees: a clear, slaty nose, pear and peach, and a fresh, elegant, finely structured finish.
items.name: 2023 Markus Molitor Haus Klosterberg Mosel Riesling

items.desc: Off-dry Kabinett from a single red-slate parcel on the Saar, planted in 1969, hand-picked, wild-fermented and never chaptalized: green apple and citrus, lightly sweet on entry and finishing dry, with a light, fresh, crystalline frame.
items.name: 2025 Stefan Muller Niedermenniger Herrenberg Feinherb Riesling

items.src: Seneca Lake, New York · Sommelier selection · by the glass 17
items.desc: Aromas of concentrated mandarin oranges. Lovely flintiness on the nose and bright lime on the mid-palate. Dry and crisp without loss of flavor.
items.name: 2024 Apollo's Praise Lahoma Vineyard Seneca Lake Scheurebe

items.desc: The perfumed, spicy grape from Cayuga Lake’s west shore, where deep water tempers a cool climate and keeps its fragrance intact: floral and zesty, with lychee, honeycomb and white pepper, and a bright, crisp finish.
items.name: 2022 Buttonwood Grove Finger Lakes Gewürztraminer

items.desc: Unoaked Riesling from the east shore of Seneca Lake, keeping a measure of natural sweetness against bright acidity: Meyer lemon, fresh apricot and ripe banana, a round, lively body, and a smooth finish of custard tart and brûléed lime.
items.name: 2019 Chateau Lafayette Reneau Finger Lakes Semi-Dry Riesling

items.desc: Cool-climate Seneca Lake fruit kept entirely out of oak, so nothing stands between grape and glass: crisp green apple and lemon, finished just off-dry, with enough ripe stone fruit to balance the bright acidity. Lovely with oysters.
items.name: 2021 Chateau Lafayette Reneau Finger Lakes Unoaked Chardonnay

items.desc: Grower-sourced fruit blended across slate, shale and clay by a Champagne-born winemaker, in a house that rests its whites on the lees: very floral and juicy, with orchard fruit and spice, layered texture and a mineral finish.
items.name: 2019 Domaine Leseurre Finger Lakes Cuvée Classique Gewürztraminer

items.desc: Riesling from growers across the region, some vines planted in 1971, fermented and aged in stainless steel with regular lees stirring: lime zest, green apple and white peach, crushed stone, and a taut, citrus-pith finish deepened by bottle age.
items.name: 2017 Domaine Leseurre Finger Lakes Cuvée Classique Dry Riesling

items.desc: Georgia’s ancient white grape, which the founder first planted in the Finger Lakes, from Keuka vines dating to 1983, fermented cool in steel with no oak: passion fruit, pineapple and apricot over a grassy, pine-like edge, round and textured, finishing crisp.
items.name: 2024 Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Rkatsiteli

items.desc: From the family’s Seneca Lake estate, vines planted in 2007 in the warm “Banana Belt,” direct-pressed and fermented cool in steel: guava, rosewater and candied lime, apricot and papaya on the finish, the palate sleek, vivid and precise.
items.name: 2023 Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Grüner Veltliner

items.desc: Georgia’s great white grape made the Georgian way: a month fermenting on its skins, another resting on them, then eight months in acacia barrels. Toasted orange peel, macerated peach and fresh ginger, ripe apricot, gentle tannic grip and a long, dried-fruit finish.
items.name: 2023 Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Amber Rkatsiteli

items.desc: From the 1985 Eric Volz Vineyard on Keuka Lake’s shale, fully barrel-fermented in French oak and acacia with weekly lees stirring: white flowers, citrus zest and fresh red apple, a round, creamy, generous palate and a hint of spice.
items.name: 2021 Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Hilda Chardonnay

items.desc: A single 2012 plot on the family’s Seneca Lake estate, in the warm “Banana Belt,” pressed directly and fermented cool in steel: lime zest, apricot, ripe melon and tropical florals over a shale core, creamy yet bright, with a long, elegant finish.
items.name: 2024 Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Margrit Dry Riesling

items.desc: Bone-dry Riesling from contracted parcels on Finger Lakes shale, made on Seneca Lake in an Austrian- and German-inspired style: yellow apple, dried lemon, candied ginger and fresh herbs over river rock and smoky minerality, intense and focused.
items.name: 2019 Empire Estate Finger Lakes Dry Reserve Riesling

items.src: Russian River Valley, California · By the glass 18
items.desc: Hillside fruit near Sebastopol, from 1987 vines in sandy Gold Ridge loam, with oak kept firmly in the background: melon, lemon and starfruit, a struck-flint, wet-stone line and just a hint of nutmeg. Lovely with shellfish.
items.name: 2023 Goldschmidt Vineyard Russian River Valley Singing Tree Chardonnay

items.desc: A smaller selection from the same 1987 hillside vines near Sebastopol, grown in sandy Gold Ridge loam: baked pear, honey and hazelnut, lily of the valley and peach blossom, a round, bright palate and a mineral, wet-stone finish.
items.name: 2021 Goldschmidt Vineyard Dutton Ranch Russian River Valley Singing Tree Reserve Chardonnay

items.desc: A cold-hardy, Muscat-descended grape bred for northern winters, grown on the north shore of Oneida Lake and made semi-dry: apricot, peach and citrus, orange blossom and a tropical edge, the acidity keeping the sweetness lively.
items.name: 2025 Grace Tyler Estate Winery Constantia, NY La Crescent

items.desc: Stainless-steel Chardonnay from the north shore of Oneida Lake, near Lake Ontario’s snow belt: lemon zest, baked apple and a hint of vanilla, a soft, creamy palate with a buttery note, and bright citrus keeping it fresh.
items.name: 2022 Grace Tyler Estate Winery Constantia, NY Chardonnay

items.desc: The Minnesota-bred, Muscat-descended white given red-wine treatment, fermented with its skins for color, texture and gentle tannin: apricot, orange peel and tropical fruit, tea, dried flowers and citrus zest. Good with dishes from the hearth.
items.name: 2022 Grace Tyler Estate Winery Constantia, NY Skin Fermented La Crescent

items.desc: Burgundy’s brisk “other” white grape, planted in 2019 over Cayuga Lake’s Onondaga limestone, hand-picked, basket-pressed and fermented in steel and neutral oak: lemon zest and fresh herbs, then white peach, green apple, a flinty line and a touch of salinity.
items.name: 2022 Heart & Hands Finger Lakes Aligoté

items.desc: Finger Lakes fruit from a ripe, sunny vintage, hand-picked, basket-pressed and aged in standard and large French oak barrels with regular lees stirring: chalky minerality, key lime and green apple, then apricot and fresh cream, finishing dry and crisp.
items.name: 2020 Heart & Hands Finger Lakes Chardonnay

items.desc: The estate’s signature blend from its west-shore Seneca Lake vineyards, picked in seventeen passes, whole-cluster pressed and wild-fermented: spring blossoms, then a succulent palate of early-season fruit kept crisp by bright acidity, with fine texture and a long, mineral finish.
items.name: 2021 Hermann J. Wiemer Vineyard Seneca Lake Dry Riesling

items.src: Seneca Lake, New York · By the glass 18
items.desc: Riesling from two blocks of the biodynamic home vineyard, picked on calendar “fruit days,” whole-cluster pressed and wild-fermented in steel: sweet citrus, Amalfi lemon and wildflowers on a light, faintly spritzy, dry palate. A lovely aperitif.
items.name: 2024 Hermann J. Wiemer Vineyard Seneca Lake Flower Day Riesling

items.src: Seneca Lake, New York · Sommelier selection · by the glass 26
items.desc: The original 1970s plantings above Seneca Lake, now Demeter-certified biodynamic, whole-cluster pressed, native-fermented and aged six months in steel: layers of citrus, white peach and tropical fruit, chalk and crushed stone, firm acidity and a clean mineral finish.
items.name: 2023 Hermann J. Wiemer Vineyard HJW Vineyard Seneca Lake Dry Riesling

items.desc: Dry Grüner from the south end of Canandaigua Lake, made in small lots with native yeasts in a cellar shaped by Austrian harvests: fresh lime and lemongrass against pollen and beeswax, zingy and light-footed, with a crisp, gently peppery finish.
items.name: 2019 Inspire Moore Finger Lakes Rhythm Grüner Veltliner

items.desc: From a family grower whose name has been on the label for more than a decade, made in a fuller, riper, Alsace-leaning style rather than crisp Pinot Grigio: melon and honeysuckle on the nose, a lush texture and a full, fruity finish.
items.name: 2023 Lakewood Vineyards Gigliotti Vineyards Pinot Gris

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York · By the glass 17
items.desc: Estate fruit from sustainably farmed vineyards around Cutchogue, the first such bottling in eight years, rested five months on its lees: gooseberry, grapefruit and lime opening toward key lime pie, a lush palate and a crisp, bone-dry finish.
items.name: 2023 Lieb Cellars North Fork of Long Island Sauvignon Blanc
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.desc: Wild-fermented in stainless steel, then rested ten months on its lees and finished bone dry: high-toned aromatics and ripe pear, a gingery spice, and a rich yet fresh palate held in balance by bright acidity.
items.name: 2021 Living Roots Finger Lakes Pinot Gris

items.desc: A richer style of the perfumed, pink-skinned grape, grown in the cool Finger Lakes, where it holds its fragrance: classic floral aromatics and intense fruit, balanced on the palate by the variety’s signature spice.
items.name: 2020 Living Roots Finger Lakes Gewürztraminer

items.desc: Cold-hardy Vidal left on the vine until after the first snows, shriveled and concentrated, its fermentation stopped early for natural sweetness: juicy peach, melon and tropical fruit, pretty florals and beeswax, all lifted by bright acidity.
items.name: 2019 Living Roots Finger Lakes Late Harvest Vidal Blanc

items.src: Finger Lakes, New York · By the glass 16
items.desc: Finger Lakes fruit left on its grey-pink skins in the copper-hued Friulian style, gaining texture and a gentle grip: blood orange, apricot and grapefruit peel, white tea and dried rose petals, with pear skin and fresh herbs.
items.name: 2024 Living Roots Finger Lakes Ramato Pinot Gris

items.desc: Fermented wild on freshly pressed Cabernet Franc skins and rested in old French oak, this skin-fermented white keeps its citrus and racy acidity while gaining rose petal, cherry, darker fruit and soft, gentle tannins.
items.name: 2022 Living Roots Finger Lakes Red Rizza Riesling

items.desc: From organic, dry-farmed vines on windblown loess over basalt in the Laurelwood District, fermented with native yeasts and bottled unfined: bracing acidity and powerful aromatics carry ripe stone fruit with balance and poise.
items.name: 2023 Maloof Nemarniki Vineyard Chehalem Mountains Fancy Free White Blend

items.desc: Direct-pressed and fermented wild, from the organic Thistle Block of Haaken Lenai Vineyard, then eight months on its lees in neutral Burgundy barrels: lemon zest, green apple and pineapple, a creamy, bready texture, ginger and white pepper, and a long finish.
items.name: 2022 Maloof Thistle Vineyard Dundee Hills Pinot Gris

items.desc: From one of the Hudson Valley’s founding estates, raised in the house style with older French oak as seasoning rather than the main event: vanilla, tangerine, caramel and pear, forward fruit and bright acidity leading to a clean finish.
items.name: 2021 Millbrook Hudson River Region Proprietor's Special Reserve Chardonnay

items.desc: Friuli’s signature white, chosen for its winter hardiness and grown on Dutchess County slopes at 800 feet, traditionally cool-fermented in steel: melon, pear, peach and tropical fruit, succulent acidity and a soft, lingering finish. Lovely with shellfish.
items.name: 2023 Millbrook Hudson River Region Proprietor's Special Reserve Tocai Friulano

items.desc: Hand-picked from two hillside sites above Sawmill Creek on Seneca Lake’s east shore, whole-cluster pressed, fermented wild and rested on its lees in neutral French barrels: lime zest, green apple and white peach over crushed stone, juicy and textured.
items.name: 2022 Osmote Finger Lakes Riesling

items.src: Seneca Lake, New York · By the glass 16
items.desc: Barrel-fermented with wild yeasts from grower vineyards around the lake and kept to a moderate 12.5%: pear and peach with spicy citrus, a mealy, creamy richness and a warm frame of French oak, balanced by fresh acidity.
items.name: 2024 Osmote Seneca Lake Chardonnay

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York
items.desc: Kept entirely out of oak so the fruit and maritime freshness of the North Fork come through unadorned: honeydew melon and chamomile, a smooth, bright palate, and a finish of citrus and ripe mango.
items.name: 2020 Pellegrini North Fork of Long Island Stainless Steel Chardonnay
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.desc: Estate fruit from the White Springs and 16 Falls vineyards in a warm, ripe year, whole-cluster pressed, cool-fermented in steel and rested on light lees: flowers, lime, white peach, fennel and pineapple, with wet stone and lively tension.
items.name: 2020 Ravines Wine Cellars Finger Lakes Dry Riesling

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York
items.desc: A Bordeaux-style white from the estate’s warmest, southernmost block, fermented and aged eleven months in French oak, half new, with lees stirring: ripe yellow apple, dried apricot and honey, a creamy, gently toasty texture and a lingering finish.
items.name: 2021 RGNY North Fork of Long Island Sauvignon Blanc – Sémillon
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York
items.desc: The northern Rhône’s fragrant white, rare on Long Island and picked ripe in the North Fork’s maritime warmth: star fruit, kiwi and apricot with flowers and a crisp, citrusy line, restrained rather than opulent.
items.name: 2021 RGNY North Fork of Long Island Viognier
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York
items.desc: Hand-harvested estate fruit fermented in stainless steel, a North Fork answer to the Loire rather than New Zealand: delicate lime and grapefruit with a touch of honeydew, crisp and mineral, finishing bright and clean. Lovely with the raw bar.
items.name: 2022 RGNY North Fork of Long Island Scielo Sauvignon Blanc
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.desc: From the east shore of Seneca Lake, where deep water lengthens a cool autumn and keeps acidity bright: honeysuckle, kiwi and lime on the nose, apple and pineapple on the palate, and a creamy finish.
items.name: 2019 Ryan William Finger Lakes Chardonnay

items.desc: From Seneca Lake’s east shore, where the deep water lets grapes hang into autumn and hold their acidity, made in a dry style: peach and slate on the nose, light pineapple on the palate and a lively, lime-edged finish.
items.name: 2019 Ryan William Seneca Lake Dry Riesling

items.desc: Alsace’s perfumed, pink-skinned grape, grown above Seneca Lake and made dry: Asian pear, rosewater and honeysuckle on the nose, then candied orange, baking spice and a hint of white pepper on a mouthwatering palate.
items.name: 2017 Ryan William Seneca Lake Dry Gewürztraminer

items.desc: Grown with biointensive, regenerative farming above Seneca Lake and made dry at just over 11%: exotic lychee and acacia blossom, a silky texture, and a palate surprisingly light, dry and delicate for the grape.
items.name: 2021 Silver Thread Finger Lakes Gewürztraminer

items.desc: Estate 89 Block fruit from Cayuga Lake’s steep west shore, raised partly in steel and partly in an Italian concrete tulip, then nine months on stirred lees: a clean, classic nose, citrus and lemongrass, crisp yet round and smooth.
items.name: 2020 Six Eighty Cellars Finger Lakes Concrete Tulip Grüner Veltliner

items.desc: Made from cool, windy Monterey County fruit, as it has been since the winery’s first vintage: rose, jasmine, lychee and candied ginger, aromatic spice and a rich body, balanced between bright acidity and fruit.
items.name: 2015 Thomas Fogarty Monterey County Gewürztraminer

items.desc: From stony, wind-swept terraces in the Te Muna Valley, fermented partly with wild yeasts in steel and French barriques and rested on lees: white flowers, peach, passionfruit and key lime, then preserved lemon, fine steely minerality and saline acidity.
items.name: 2025 Craggy Range Te Muna Road Vineyard Martinborough Sauvignon Blanc

items.desc: A single certified-organic vineyard on the southern side of the Wairau Valley, wild-fermented partly in old 500-liter barrels with half through malolactic: lemon peel, orange blossom and flint, yellow plum and dusty citrus, quieter and rounder than the regional norm.
items.name: 2024 Deep Down Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc

items.desc: Single-vineyard fruit from the stony old riverbed soils of Rapaura, cold-fermented in steel: ripe pear, apricot and passionfruit with a hint of Asian spice, then a mouthwatering palate of makrut lime, hibiscus and pink grapefruit. Lovely with oysters.
items.name: 2024 Goldschmidt Vineyard Marlborough 'Nick Goldschmidt Boulder Bank' Sauvignon Blanc

items.desc: Parcels from the lower Wairau Valley, vinified separately, fermented cool in stainless steel and finished dry: passionfruit, guava and blackcurrant with nettle and snow pea, then gooseberry, grapefruit and white stone fruit, long and flinty.
items.name: 2024 Saint Clair Family Estate Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc

items.desc: The Loire’s great white grape, a rarity in the Finger Lakes, grown on the Cayuga Lake side and made dry and medium-bodied: honeysuckle, lemon and honeydew, then a bright, mouthwatering palate of pear skin and lime, finishing soft and round.
items.name: 2024 Six Eighty Cellars Chenin Blanc

items.desc: Pressed straight away from two vineyards on Seneca Lake’s southwest side, with little skin contact and no oak: cherry, watermelon and nectarine, flowers and a lift of herbs, dry and crisp.
items.name: 2022 Anthony Road Finger Lakes Cabernet Franc Rosé

items.desc: A crisp, dry rosé from the Hudson Valley house that has made wine since 1839, using grapes chosen from independent New York growers: wild strawberry, red cherry and watermelon with citrus peel, then red berries, cranberry and pink grapefruit.
items.name: 2024 Brotherhood New York Premium Selection Dry Rosé

items.desc: Malbec, Tannat and Cabernet Franc from the Applegate Valley, pressed straight off the skins and fermented wild in neutral French oak: juicy strawberry, pink apple, Meyer lemon and yellow cherry, raw almond and wet stone, crisp with gentle grip.
items.name: 2022 Day Wines Rogue Valley Babycheeks Rosé

items.desc: Gamay and Cabernet Franc from organic, granite-soiled vines at nearly 3,000 feet, pressed as whole clusters, fermented wild and aged in neutral puncheons: stone fruit, spring flowers and grapefruit peel, then citrus, melon, early strawberry and a saline edge.
items.name: 2024 Jolie Laide Barsotti Vineyard El Dorado County Rosé

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York · By the glass 15
items.desc: Merlot, Malbec and Cabernet Franc from the estate, made for color and freshness rather than weight: pale salmon, with strawberry, cherry and a touch of lychee, a bright start and a long, elegant finish.
items.name: NV RGNY North Fork of Long Island Scielo NY Rosé
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.desc: Hondarrabi Beltza drawn off after a few cold hours on its skins and blended with Hondarrabi Zuri: strawberry, blackberry and blackcurrant over citrus and a fine vegetal note, lifted by a light natural prickle and balanced acidity. Lovely with shellfish.
items.name: 2024 Hiruzta Getariako Txakolina Rosé

items.desc: Getaria’s two native grapes from steep Atlantic slopes, fermented cold with native yeasts in steel and bottled with a natural prickle: strawberry, lime, white flowers and minerals, then tangy red berry and citrus with a hint of white pepper.
items.name: 2016 Txomin Etxaniz Getariako Txakolina 'Getaria' Rosé

items.src: The Hamptons, New York · By the glass 16
items.desc: Mostly Cabernet Franc with dabs of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot, grown on Atlantic-cooled South Fork soils: cassis, figs, licorice, leather and toasted sandalwood, medium-bodied with velvety tannins and fresh acidity. Natural with wood-fired meats.
items.name: 2023 Wölffer Estate Vineyard Long Island Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Grown on Bridgehampton loam two and a half miles from the Atlantic and framed by fine toasted oak: sandalwood, prunes, ripe blueberries and licorice, then an elegant, firm palate with minerality, ripe tannins and a hint of bell pepper.
items.name: 2019 Wölffer Estate Vineyard The Hamptons, Long Island Cabernet Franc

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York · By the glass 18
items.desc: Sustainably farmed estate fruit aged ten months in gentle Hungarian oak: dark cherry and cranberry on the nose, then ripe plum, plush dark fruit and a touch of graphite over fine, elegant tannins.
items.name: 2022 Lieb Cellars North Fork of Long Island Estate Merlot
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.desc: Lifted by a little Cabernet Franc, from the warm, south-facing Wahluke Slope with cool river nights: plum, cherry and blackberry, then tobacco, cedar and clove with vanilla and mocha, rounded tannins and a smooth finish.
items.name: 2022 Luke Wahluke Slope Merlot

items.desc: Old-vine Zinfandel from a small Geyserville vineyard first planted in the late 1800s, at the northern end of Alexander Valley: blackberry jam, plum and fresh cherry, licorice and cracked pepper, rounded tannins and a long, supple finish.
items.name: 2023 Goldschmidt Vineyard The Railyard Alexander Valley Fidelity Zinfandel

items.desc: Zinfandel from a granite plateau some 1,650 feet up in the Sierra Foothills, picked at night and aged in American and French oak: jammy raspberry and blackberry, cinnamon, licorice and bittersweet chocolate over briary tannins. Built for smoke and char.
items.name: 2022 Rombauer Twin Rivers Single Vineyard El Dorado Zinfandel

items.desc: Tempranillo with a touch of Graciano from clay-limestone slopes beneath the Sierra de Cantabria, aged at least three years before release: ripe cherry, licorice and vanilla, dusty spice and a hint of pine cone, finishing gently sweet and fruity.
items.name: 2017 Eguren Ugarte Rioja Reserva Tempranillo

items.desc: High-altitude Malbec from the limestone soils of Gualtallary in the Uco Valley, fermented with native yeasts and aged largely in big old foudres: blackberry, dark cherry and violets, a touch of pepper and dark spice, with fine, chalky tannins.
items.name: 2022 El Enemigo Mendoza Malbec

items.desc: Mostly Cabernet with a splash of Merlot and Petit Verdot, from a sun-drenched slope cooled at night by the Columbia River, aged in French and American oak: marionberry, blackberry and currant, dark chocolate and a hint of mint, cedar, smoke and polished tannins.
items.name: 2021 Luke Wahluke Slope Cabernet Sauvignon

items.desc: Dry-farmed, native-yeast Bordeaux blend from the former Cinnabar estate, one ridge south of Mount Eden: loamy earth, currant, blackberry and cedar, then bright blue fruit, black plum and tobacco over plush, well-knit tannins.
items.name: 2019 Mount Eden Vineyards Santa Cruz Mountains 'Domaine Eden' Cabernet Sauvignon

items.desc: A barrel selection from the estate’s best blocks beneath the palisades, aged 19 months in French oak: black cherry, blackberry and plum lifted by wild lavender, cola nut and espresso, full-bodied with chewy tannins and a graphite, mocha finish.
items.name: 2020 Stags' Leap Napa Valley 'The Leap' Cabernet Sauvignon

items.src: Wahluke Slope, Washington · Sommelier selection · by the glass 30
items.desc: Single-vineyard Syrah from Stone Tree, wild-fermented in concrete with about a fifth whole clusters and aged on its lees, unfined and unfiltered: crushed dark berries, violets, cured olive and smoked meat, mocha and dried herbs, velvety and deep.
items.name: 2018 Luke Wahluke Slope Reserve Syrah

items.desc: Aromas of red fruits, black fruits, dried roses and citrus. Reminiscent of Provençal rosé with additional dark fruits, earth but with the structure of red wine.
items.name: 2022 The Language of Yes Cuvée Sinsó Syrah

items.desc: Nebbiolo blended with local Vespolina from Boca’s volcanic hills at the foot of the Alps, fermented in old cement and aged in large casks: dark cherry, cedar and plum, orange zest and thyme, with firm, old-school tannins. Worth decanting.
items.name: 2018 Antonio Vallana E Figlio Boca Nebbiolo Blend

items.desc: Nebbiolo from southwest-facing Roero vineyards across the Tanaro, macerated 25 days in steel and aged 14 months in French oak: violets and ripe blackberry, fine and well structured, a younger, open-hearted glimpse of the house style.
items.name: 2023 Bruno Giacosa Nebbiolo D'Alba

items.desc: Merlot-led, from gravel and iron-rich sands, fermented in concrete with only a light touch of new oak: black cherry, violet and juicy red fruit, a hint of licorice and citrus peel, creamy and round with silky, fine tannins.
items.name: 2020 Château de Sales Pomerol Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Cabernet-led and assembled plot by plot from classified-growth vineyards on deep Médoc gravel, in a celebrated vintage: cassis, blackberry, blueberry and plum, a touch of leather, ripe tannins and bright acidity, now opening into its drinking window.
items.name: 2016 Château Gloria Saint-Julien Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Mostly Cabernet Sauvignon from a single block of deep gravel on the hills behind the town, aged in largely new French oak: ripe black fruit and licorice lifted by freshness and minerality, then a precise, dense palate and a long, firm finish.
items.name: 2018 Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste Pauillac Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Cabernet-driven, from deep gravel over limestone in a great, structured vintage: very ripe cassis with a touch of spice, blackberry and crushed rock, a powerful, balanced frame and real freshness, with cedar and tobacco beginning to emerge.
items.name: 2010 Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste Pauillac Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: The château’s third wine, drawn from younger vines including the Tour Pibran plots and made by the same team as the grand vin: ripe plum and blackberry, supple and fruity, with soft tannins and a long, persistent finish. Ready now.
items.name: 2019 Château Pichon-Longueville Baron 'Pauillac de Pichon-Longueville Baron' Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Biodynamically farmed and horse-ploughed beside Mouton, aged partly in concrete amphorae: a pure, powerful nose of cassis, plum and spice, then a dense, full, refreshing palate with succulent, precise tannins and a long mineral finish.
items.name: 2016 Château Pontet-Canet Pauillac Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: From deep gravel beside Mouton, in one of Bordeaux’s great vintages and built to last: cherry, blackberry and cassis now joined by cedar, graphite and tobacco, with dense tannins and a saline, pencil-lead finish.
items.name: 2005 Château Pontet-Canet Pauillac Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Organic, Cabernet-led red from the gravel rise of Martillac, aged 18 months on its lees in barrels from the estate’s own cooperage: spice, cedar, licorice and violet with a hint of flint, then a dense, silky palate finishing floral and mineral.
items.name: 2015 Château Smith Haut Lafitte Pessac-Léognan Grand Cru Classé Black Label Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Cabernet-led, from one of the highest gravel rises in the heart of the commune, fermented in wooden vats: crème de cassis, boysenberry and plum, licorice, roasted herbs and smoke, full and fleshy with deep, ripe tannins.
items.name: 2010 Château Talbot Saint-Julien Grand Cru Classé Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Old-vine Grenache with Cinsault, Mourvèdre and a touch of Syrah from the Les Serres parcel, farmed biodynamically, fermented whole-cluster and aged in demi-muids: black raspberry, Provençal herbs and ground pepper, fine-grained tannins and an elegant, focused finish.
items.name: 2021 Domaine Saint Préfert Châteauneuf-Du-Pape Isabel Ferrando Rhône Blend

items.desc: Garnacha, Cariñena and a little Syrah from 25-year-old vines on Priorat’s black licorella slate, bottled unfined and unfiltered: wild strawberry, black raspberry and red licorice, cracked pepper, a velvety texture and a mineral finish.
items.name: 2022 Merum Priorati Priorat Destí Red Blend

items.desc: Garnacha-led, with Cariñena, Syrah and Cabernet, grown on licorella slate and raised in French oak: sun-warmed stone, flowers, balsamic and aniseed, then fresh raspberry and pomegranate on a round palate with smoky nuances and fine tannins.
items.name: 2022 Merum Priorati Priorat Inici Red Blend

items.desc: Unoaked Barbera from several vineyards in southern Asti, matured in steel and bottle to keep it bright: violet, red cherry and wild berries with a hint of spice, juicy and food-friendly, with a savory finish. Lovely with pasta and grilled meats.
items.name: 2022 Michele Chiarlo Le Orme Barbera D'Asti

items.desc: The Hudson Valley estate’s everyday red, a soft, medium-weight blend of New York fruit: jammy blackberry and plum on the nose, darker berries on the palate with a touch of smoke and spice. Easy with roast pork or wood-fired pizza.
items.name: 2022 Millbrook New York State Hunt Country Red Blend

items.desc: Merlot-led, with Cabernet, Malbec and Petit Verdot from mountain and valley-floor vineyards: crushed black cherry, mushroom and leather, then black currant laced with mocha and toasty spice, plush and polished. Open and generous now.
items.name: 2021 Pahlmeyer Napa Valley Jayson Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Montepulciano and Sangiovese from organic, east-facing hills near Offida, fermented with native yeasts and kept out of oak: brambly fruit and thyme, medium-bodied and fruit-forward, with fresh acidity keeping it bright. An easy partner for the grill.
items.name: 2024 Tenuta de Angelis Rosso Piceno Red Blend

items.desc: Aromas of wild rose, cherries, mint, cassis and licorice. Flavor of white chocolate, vanilla and cedar on a buttery bed of oak verticalized by a gentle acidity.
items.name: 2017 Tenuta di Ceppaiano Toscana K. Haring Red Blend

items.desc: Old-vine Barbera from Castiglione Falletto, Monforte and neighboring Langhe villages, aged about fourteen months in oak: ripe red and dark cherry, plum, vanilla and a hint of mocha, with bright acidity and sweet, well-integrated tannins.
items.name: 2022 Vietti Trevie Barbera D'Alba

items.desc: Village Pommard from a single lieu-dit high on the slope, on shallow, pale limestone, from a warm, ripe vintage: cherry and black currant with gentle spice, soft tannins and a warm, powerful, complex finish, now in its mature phase.
items.name: 2018 Alain Corcia Les Vignots Pommard Pinot Noir

items.desc: A rare still red from Champagne: organic Meunier from Chamery, fermented as whole bunches with wild yeasts and aged in sandstone eggs, unfined and unsulfured. Bright cherry, plum and raspberry, juicy and lively, with a fine-grained grip.
items.name: 2022 Bonnet-Ponson Chamery Rouge Coteaux Champenois

items.desc: Organic Malbec from a single 40-year-old plot on red clay and limestone high on the Causse, named for its cherry tree and aged in cement only: dark cherry and blackberry, floral lift, a whisper of earth and spice, polished tannins.
items.name: 2021 Château Combel La Serre Cahors Au Cerisier Malbec

items.desc: Cabernet, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot from gravel and clay in Cantenac, fermented in concrete tulip vats: dark fruit, black pepper, cinnamon and vanilla, then a fresh palate of velvety tannins with cocoa and coffee and a long finish.
items.name: 2015 Château Kirwan Margaux Grand Cru Classé Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Cabernet and Merlot with an unusually generous 18% Petit Verdot, from gravel over a rare vein of blue clay above the Gironde: black raspberry, cedar and incense, barrel spice and sweet tobacco, with muscular tannins and real grip.
items.name: 2018 Château Meyney Saint-Estèphe Cru Bourgeois Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Cabernet, Merlot and the estate’s signature Petit Verdot, from gravel over blue clay overlooking the Gironde, in a great, structured vintage: black currant and red berries, graphite and savory spice, fresh fruit over dense, softened tannins.
items.name: 2010 Château Meyney Saint-Estèphe Cru Bourgeois Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Village Pommard assembled from fifteen small plots, about 15% whole bunch and framed by a light touch of new oak: wild strawberry, black cherry and raspberry, bramble and black currant, iron and fresh mint, firm tannins coated in fruit.
items.name: 2023 Domaine Cyrot-Buthiau Pommard Pinot Noir

items.desc: Cabernet Franc from sixty-year-old vines around the house in Restigné, on clay and micaceous chalk over tuffeau, fermented with native yeasts and aged in old oak: red currant, raspberry and black cherry, with graphite, dried herbs and an earthy finish.
items.name: 2019 Domaine de La Chevalerie Bourgueil 'Chevalerie' Cabernet Franc

items.desc: A single plot of forty-year-old vines on the tuffeau plateau above the Loire, fermented with native yeasts and raised a year in steel, bottled unfiltered: brambly dark berries, wild strawberry and a sous-bois undertone, juicy and fresh.
items.name: 2023 Domaine Filliatreau Saumur-Champigny La Grande Vignolle Cabernet Franc

items.desc: From the very top of the Gevrey slope, just below the forest, on limestone, aged in used barrels with no new oak: wild berries and currant, cool and airy, the crunch of red fruit balanced by stony minerality.
items.name: 2021 Domaine Trapet-Rochelandet Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Bel Air Pinot Noir

items.desc: Fifty- to sixty-year-old Gamay on volcanic granite, destemmed and fermented with native yeasts in concrete over three to four weeks, not carbonic: vibrant cherry, strawberry and a wisp of smoke, soft tannins and a deep, lingering finish.
items.name: 2022 Jean-Paul Brun Côte de Brouilly Terres Dorées Gamay

items.desc: Syrah from iron-rich schist slopes across the appellation, from Côte Blonde to Côte Brune, fermented with native yeasts in concrete and aged mostly in new oak: raspberry and violet over spice, undergrowth and black olive, velvety, with a spicy vanilla finish.
items.name: 2020 M. Chapoutier Côte-Rôtie Les Bécasses Syrah

items.desc: Syrah from three Crozes terroirs, granite, puddingstone and river terrace, farmed biodynamically, fermented in rough concrete and aged in seasoned demi-muids: blackberry, cassis, dark chocolate and cracked pepper, full-bodied, with a long finish.
items.name: 2023 M. Chapoutier Crozes-Hermitage Sicamor Syrah

items.desc: Fifty-year-old vines on a south-facing slope of clay over tuffeau, whole berries fermented a month in steel, then long aging in large old foudres: perfumed plum, raspberry, wild blackberry and crushed flowers, chalky tannins and a peppery finish.
items.name: 2020 Olga Raffault Chinon Les Picasses Cabernet Franc

items.desc: From vines over fifty years old on clay and tuffeau above the Vienne, fermented in steel and aged slowly in large neutral casks before a late release: black currant, blackberry, Morello cherry, prune, licorice and cocoa; superb with wood-fired meats.
items.name: 2019 Olga Raffault Les Picasses Chinon Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Sangiovese from a single parcel on spungone, a fossil-rich sandstone, fermented with native yeasts in open wooden vats and aged two years in old Slavonian oak: red cherry, plum and wild strawberry, orange peel and violets, firm, refined tannins.
items.name: 2021 Chiara Condello Le Lucciole Predappio Riserva Sangiovese

items.desc: Nebbiolo from the windswept hills where the Langhe meets Monferrato, farmed with organic and biodynamic methods; with years in bottle it shows plum and Maraschino cherry, a rich, elegant palate, hints of spice and sweet, softened tannins.
items.name: 2018 Col Dei Venti Langhe Lampio Nebbiolo

items.desc: Nerello Mascalese from high contrade on Etna’s north slope, some from bush vines on old terraces, in sandy lava soils, aged partly in used barriques: cherry, raspberry and wild berries, a hint of star anise, fine tannins and a mineral core.
items.name: 2022 Donnafugata Etna Rosso Sul Vulcano Nerello Mascalese

items.desc: Nebbiolo from the Casot cru in Treiso, on calcareous marl, fermented spontaneously with a long maceration and aged two years in large old casks: dark red fruit, spice, flowers and balsamic tones, fine, elegant tannins and a persistent finish.
items.name: 2020 Giuseppe Nada Casot Barbaresco Nebbiolo

items.desc: Tempranillo from clay-limestone slopes beneath Laguardia, aged fourteen months in American and French oak and bottled unfined and unfiltered: raspberry, strawberry and a touch of oak, then plum, cherry and sweet spice, chalky tannins and a fresh finish.
items.name: 2017 Eguren Ugarte Rioja Cincuenta Tempranillo

items.desc: A rare single-variety Graciano from one plot of forty-year-old organic vines in Corella, fermented with native yeasts in French oak and bottled unfined and unfiltered: perfumed and floral, with cranberry, dark cherry and light spice, and gentle tannin.
items.name: 2021 Viña Zorzal Cuatro del Cuatro Graciano

items.desc: Forty-year-old bush-vine Garnacha from a single high plot in the Fitero hills, on rocky clay and limestone, farmed organically and aged in used large barrels and foudre: blackberry, black pepper and mint, supple and medium-bodied, with mountain freshness.
items.name: 2021 Viña Zorzal Malayeto Garnacha

items.desc: Pinot Noir drawn from sites across the valley to show the house style, with sustainably farmed estate fruit: dark cherry, red raspberry and orange zest on the nose, then dark and red cherry, black tea and spice, fresh and supple.
items.name: 2023 Argyle Willamette Valley Pinot Noir

items.desc: Merlot from America’s oldest winery, made in a Right Bank Bordeaux mold: plummy and generous but with backbone, dark fruit and savory herbs on a dry, medium- to full-bodied frame; a natural partner for lamb, beef or duck.
items.name: 2017 Brotherhood New York Premium Selection Merlot

items.desc: Estate hillside Cabernet Sauvignon with Merlot and a little Cabernet Franc, from Rutherford and St. Helena, aged in French oak and large foudres for finesse over power: cassis, plum and cherry, graphite, tobacco and red flowers, over very fine tannins.
items.name: 2021 Cathiard Vineyard Napa Valley Founding Brothers Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Shows blackberry, graphite and violet notes as well as medium-plus tannins. Lots of red cherry on the finish, as well as some chocolate.
items.name: 2023 Chateau Lafayette Reneau Finger Lakes Cabernet Sauvignon

items.desc: Cool-climate Pinot Noir from stony shale slopes on Seneca Lake’s east shore: cherry, tea leaf and a touch of toffee, smooth tannins and a moderate finish, light-footed and savory rather than big; lovely with roast poultry or mushrooms.
items.name: 2019 Chateau Lafayette Reneau Finger Lakes Pinot Noir

items.src: Seneca Lake, New York · By the glass 12
items.desc: Cool-climate Syrah from stony shale slopes on Seneca Lake’s east shore, where the deep lake stretches the season: black fruit, plum and black cherry with a spicy edge, then savory meatiness, black pepper and oak spice.
items.name: 2019 Chateau Lafayette Reneau Finger Lakes Syrah

items.desc: Seneca Lake Cabernet Franc fermented with native yeast, 10% whole clusters and a saignée, then a year in neutral French oak, unfined and unfiltered: stewed berries, cocoa and cigar box, savory dark fruit, bramble and clove, with bright acidity.
items.name: 2023 Damiani Wine Cellars Finger Lakes Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Biodynamic Pinot Noir from a wind-cooled site in the Coast Range gap, about 40% whole cluster: dried rose, sour cherry, cranberry and blood orange, with sage, tea and tobacco, medium-bodied, firm acidity and a long finish; lovely decanted.
items.name: 2021 Day Wines Johan Vineyards Van Duzer Corridor Pinot Noir

items.desc: Cabernet Franc from the winery’s best lots, given the house’s long élevage of at least two years in barrel and one in bottle: strawberry, raspberry and a hint of cola, then gentle red fruit and black pepper.
items.name: 2018 Domaine Leseurre Finger Lakes Barrel Select Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Mostly Seneca Lake fruit with older Keuka vines, from a freeze-shortened crop, cold-soaked and aged sixteen months in French oak: black cherry, blackberry and fig, florals, dried herbs and green peppercorn, fruit-forward yet structured, with grippy tannins.
items.name: 2023 Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Cabernet Sauvignon

items.desc: Mostly Seneca Lake fruit, cold-soaked, fermented in open-top steel and aged about sixteen months in French oak: black cherry, cassis, vanilla and chocolate with a thread of tobacco, silky tannins and cool-climate freshness.
items.name: 2022 Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Merlot

items.desc: From the family’s Seneca Lake vines in Hector, a hot, dry season ripened fully into October before eighteen months in French oak: fresh plum, red berries and violet, juicy acidity, earthy spice and cedar.
items.name: 2020 Dr. Konstantin Frank Finger Lakes Blaufränkisch

items.desc: Pinot Noir blended from several sites on Seneca’s east shore, hand-picked, fermented with native yeasts and lightly oaked: dark cherry, flowers, cocoa and black pepper, elegant and silky, with fresh acidity.
items.name: 2024 Forge Cellars Seneca Lake Classique Pinot Noir

items.desc: Cabernet Franc from one of the northernmost sites Forge works on Seneca Lake, hand-picked and fermented with native yeasts: high-toned red fruit, savory herbs and fine tannins in a fresh, Loire-leaning style; it takes a light chill well.
items.name: 2024 Forge Cellars Seneca Lake Willow Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Single-vineyard Cabernet Franc from Seneca Lake, hand-harvested and fermented with native yeasts: wild red and dark fruit, earth and wild herbs, with fine tannins and a fresh, Old World profile; good with lamb or duck.
items.name: 2023 Forge Cellars Caywood Vineyard Seneca Lake Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Cabernet Sauvignon from warm Seneca Lake sites, light on its feet at 12.2%: black currant, plum, graphite and garden soil, wild strawberry and baking spice, finishing on dried plum and black tea, New World fruit with Old World balance.
items.name: 2023 Glenora Wine Cellars Finger Lakes Cabernet Sauvignon

items.desc: Single-vineyard Merlot from Guidestone Rise, now nearly a decade in bottle: red raspberry, black cherry and spice, then a full, round palate of plum, red currant, blackberry and bay leaf, softening toward savory, earthy tones.
items.name: 2017 Goldschmidt Vineyard Alexander Valley 'Chelsea Goldschmidt' Merlot

items.desc: From a 1989 hillside planting on sandy loam, aged in French oak with only 15% new and left unfined: cherry, blueberry and raspberry, black plum and dark chocolate, a touch of vanilla, fine tannins and a plush finish.
items.name: 2023 Goldschmidt Vineyard Stonemason Hill Alexander Valley 'Katherine Goldschmidt' Cabernet Sauvignon

items.desc: Two barrels from a steep, organically farmed two-acre knoll above Game Ranch, planted in 1988 and held back for extra bottle age: blackberry, black cherry and dark plum, pencil shavings and a mint-chocolate edge, silky tannins and a long, dusty finish.
items.name: 2018 Goldschmidt Vineyard Oakville Ultimatum Double Rock Cabernet Sauvignon

items.desc: Estate Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon from Seneca Lake’s east shore, aged in French oak: caramel, vanilla and cinnamon from the barrel, then sweet cherry and blackberry, soft tannins and a light strawberry finish.
items.name: 2021 Hazlitt 1852 Vineyard Finger Lakes Meritage Red Blend

items.desc: The estate reserve, from Onondaga limestone near Cayuga Lake’s shore, hand punched down in open-top vats and aged in French oak: black cherry and chalky minerality, then cranberry and cassis, with a long, dry finish.
items.name: 2021 Heart & Hands Mo Chuisle Pinot Noir

items.desc: From the estate’s ripest site, vines planted in 2004, wild-fermented with a quarter whole clusters and aged in neutral French and Hungarian oak: dark fruit and herbs, firm tannins opening to black cherry, red plum and spiced cranberry.
items.name: 2023 Hermann J. Wiemer Vineyard Magdalena Vineyard Seneca Lake Cabernet Franc

items.desc: A Rhône-inspired blend led by Grenache and Syrah, with Petite Sirah, Mourvèdre and Graciano from sites between Sonoma and the Sierra Foothills: blackberry, spiced plum and dark cherry, star anise, cocoa and a touch of lavender.
items.name: 2022 Keplinger California Vermillion Red Blend

items.desc: The old name for Blaufränkisch, grown on Seneca Lake’s west shore for a dry, medium-bodied red: raspberry, strawberry and cracked pepper, then red cherry, pomegranate and plum, lively acidity and a dry, gently spiced finish.
items.name: 2021 Lakewood Vineyards Finger Lakes Lemberger

items.desc: A single estate block on Seneca Lake’s east shore, made for freshness rather than weight: cedar, cinnamon and warm spice over ripe plum and cherry, supple tannins, earthy freshness and a generous finish.
items.name: 2021 Lamoreaux Landing Finger Lakes Block 137 Merlot

items.desc: Austria’s great cool-climate red, at home in the Finger Lakes’ short seasons: lifted red fruit and spice, a juicy palate edged with white pepper, and very fine, delicate tannins in a lighter-bodied, balanced glass.
items.name: 2024 Living Roots Finger Lakes Blaufränkisch

items.desc: Made for freshness, with a high share of whole berries, wild fermentation and no fining or filtering: cranberry and tart cherry, a subtle peppery spice and lively acidity in a bright, medium-bodied red.
items.name: 2023 Living Roots Finger Lakes Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Hudson Valley estate fruit blended with Long Island Pinot Noir: raspberry and black currant lifted by soft rose petal, then cherry and plum with soft tannins and a smooth, lingering finish.
items.name: 2024 Millbrook New York State Pinot Noir

items.desc: Dry-farmed on a north-facing slope at 1,600 feet, a mosaic of Dijon and historic California clones, native-fermented and aged in older French oak: raspberry, anise and a touch of vanilla, fresh acidity and supporting tannins.
items.name: 2019 Mount Eden Vineyards Santa Cruz Mountains 'Domaine Eden' Pinot Noir

items.desc: Ungrafted vines, many over forty years old, from three old organic and biodynamic Oregon sites, native-fermented and bottled unfiltered: forest floor, black olive and cocoa over dark berries and cherry, a spice-box lift and fine, grainy structure.
items.name: 2022 Nicolas-Jay Willamette Valley Own-Rooted Pinot Noir

items.desc: Estate fruit from two Seneca Lake sites, given weeks on the skins and fourteen months in large, three-year-old Austrian casks: redcurrant, cranberry and mountain herbs, then pure raspberry with hints of earth and spice.
items.name: 2022 Ravines Wine Cellars Finger Lakes Cabernet Franc

items.src: Finger Lakes, New York · By the glass 16
items.desc: From Seneca Lake’s western slope, mostly native-fermented, partly aged in neutral oak and never filtered: rose petal, black pepper, plum and cassis, then cranberry and blackberry, bright acidity and fine tannins. It takes a slight chill well.
items.name: 2023 Red Tail Ridge RTR Estate Vineyard Finger Lakes Blaufränkisch

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York · By the glass 16
items.desc: A Bordeaux-style blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot from the estate’s sandy loam: red berries and black cherry, dark chocolate and baking spice, fresh acidity and soft, elegant tannins.
items.name: 2019 RGNY North Fork of Long Island Scielo NY Tinto
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.desc: Merlot from a farm winery above Seneca Lake: black cherry and blackberry with a balsamic edge and a touch of barrel, then lush dark cherry, savory herbs, dried earth and crushed blueberry.
items.name: 2020 Ryan William Finger Lakes Merlot

items.desc: Georgia’s ancient red-fleshed grape and the estate’s signature since 2005, from 10- to 25-year-old vines, native-fermented in steel with some whole clusters and rested ten months, mostly in neutral Hungarian oak: deeply colored and fresh.
items.name: 2023 Standing Stone Vineyards Seneca Lake Teinturier Saperavi

items.desc: Wölffer’s top-tier White Horse red, a Merlot-led blend with Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon: ripe cassis and raspberry with an inky, iodine note, classic minerality, toasted oak and roasted nuts over velvety tannins. Decant it for an hour.
items.name: 2020 Wölffer Estate Vineyard Long Island Fatalis Fatum Cabernet Franc

items.src: North Fork of Long Island, New York
items.desc: Winemaker Roman Roth’s own label, from Sam McCullough’s North Fork vineyard: cassis, plum and chocolate with cinnamon and sandalwood, a rich, round palate touched with black pepper and olive tapenade, and a long finish of licorice and fig.
items.name: 2020 Wölffer Estate Vineyard Long Island The Grapes of Roth Merlot
items.appellation: North Fork of Long Island, New York

items.src: South Australia, Australia · By the glass 20
items.desc: Cabernet Sauvignon and Tannat from the Hardy family’s Kuitpo vineyards, the Tannat softened by ten days of carbonic maceration: vibrant strawberry and cherry, savory herbs, supple tannins and a spicy finish.
items.name: 2021 Living Roots Adelaide Hills Cabernet – Tannat

items.desc: Cool-climate Shiraz, half fermented in open vats and half by carbonic maceration, all on wild yeasts: lifted dark fruit, fresh acidity, and spicy, savory notes in balance, closer to a peppery Syrah than a blockbuster.
items.name: 2020 Living Roots Adelaide Hills From The Hills Shiraz

items.desc: Malbec-led, with Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Petit Verdot from high, calcareous Gualtallary soils, aged in a century-old foudre: cocoa, red fruit and orange peel over herbal, minty spice, fresh acidity and a dry, chalky finish.
items.name: 2020 El Enemigo Mendoza 'Gran Enemigo' Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Village Malbec from high-altitude calcareous sand, caliche and stone at the foot of the Andes, native-fermented in concrete and bottled unfiltered: fresh red fruit and plum with an herbal lift, lively acidity and fine tannins.
items.name: 2020 Familia Zuccardi Gualtallary Polígonos del Valle de Uco Malbec

items.desc: Wölffer’s Argentine Malbec, grown at about 4,100 feet in Alto Agrelo’s sandy loam and made with Dominio del Plata: blueberry and fig, then black cherry and dark chocolate, velvety tannins, chalky minerality and a touch of iodine.
items.name: 2024 Wölffer Estate Vineyard Mendoza 'Finca Wölffer' Malbec

items.desc: Beaujolais’s grape and a house specialty, grown in the cool Finger Lakes for a fully dry, light-bodied red: bright and fresh, low in alcohol and easy at the table.
items.name: 2024 Bet The Farm Gamay Noir
Terroir Silex Sancerre Gerard Fiou Artisan Vigneron

items.desc: Botrytised Sémillon with Sauvignon Blanc and a touch of Muscadelle, picked over eight passes and barrel-fermented, then aged in French oak: orange, grapefruit, pineapple and peach, broom flower and toasted brioche on a powerful yet fresh palate.
items.name: 2016 Château Coutet Barsac Premier Cru Classé Sauternes

items.desc: From America’s oldest winery, fortified with brandy to keep its natural grape sweetness, then blended through a modified solera in old port casks: sweet, rich and velvety, with dark fruit and chocolate. Lovely with blue cheese.
items.name: NV Brotherhood New York Ruby Port

items.desc: A long-standing tasting-room favorite from Seneca Lake’s first winery, fortified to 18% and finished sweet with balancing acidity: rich raspberry and a touch of vanilla, lovely with dark chocolate or berry desserts.
items.name: NV Glenora Wine Cellars Finger Lakes Port

items.desc: Made in the Portuguese manner from very ripe, partly raisined Baco Noir and other cold-hardy Finger Lakes grapes: deep scarlet, with black raspberry and currant on the nose and a velvety, warm palate of cassis and a hint of anise.
items.name: 2020 Lakewood Vineyards Finger Lakes Port

items.desc: Estate Riesling, frozen and pressed for a trickle of concentrated juice and made in small quantities: golden raisin, apricot and honey, rich enough to stand in for dessert, held in balance by Riesling’s bright acidity.
items.name: 2019 Lamoreaux Landing Finger Lakes Riesling Ice Wine

items.desc: Pressed from frozen grapes and kept in stainless steel, so only concentrated juice runs from the press: light floral aromas, then fresh, lingering ripe pear and citrus, with Vidal’s bright acidity keeping the sweetness lifted.
items.name: 2021 Wagner Vineyards Finger Lakes Vidal Blanc Ice Wine

items.desc: Late-harvested white grapes, usually led by Chardonnay, frozen after picking and pressed for intensely sweet juice: ripe apricot and honey, then apricot jam on a rich, honeyed palate kept fresh by lively acidity.
items.name: 2021 Wölffer Estate Vineyard The Hamptons Diosa Late Harvest Ice Wine

items.desc: Young Port from Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca and other native Douro grapes, fortified mid-fermentation and aged two to three years in large oak vats: concentrated blackcurrant and cherry, then a full, firm palate of black fruit.
items.name: NV Taylor Fladgate Fine Ruby Port

items.src: Fruit of the Fungi · Lebanon, NY
items.desc: Bacon, thyme, poached egg, chives
items.name: Mushroom Toast
items.pair: 2023 Wölffer Estate Vineyard Long Island Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Egg yolk, shallot, parsley, whole grain mustard, pickled vegetables, toast points
items.name: Beef Tartare
items.pair: NV Hermann J. Wiemer Vineyard Seneca Lake Extra Brut Méthode Champenoise Sparkling Wine

items.desc: Braised leeks, fried halloumi, confit garlic, Champaign vinaigrette
items.name: Green Lentil Salad
items.pair: 2023 Lieb Cellars North Fork of Long Island Sauvignon Blanc

items.desc: Goat cheese, oranges, candied almonds, arugula
items.name: Beet and Carrot Salad
items.pair: NV RGNY North Fork of Long Island Scielo NY Rosé
